links.outcome: Readability (Coleman-Liau and SMOG indices) of LLM patient education responses on upper blepharoplasty
links.effect: Claude 3.5 Sonnet was most complex (Coleman-Liau 17.34; SMOG 23.82); Gemini 2.0 Flash was most comprehensible (Coleman-Liau 13.27; SMOG 15.04), all well above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: Claude 3.5 Sonnet generated the most complex responses (Coleman-Liau index: 17.34; SMOG index: 23.82 points), whereas Google Gemini 2.0 Flash produced the most comprehensible texts (Coleman-Liau index: 13.27; SMOG index: 15.04 points).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy and readability of three commercial LLMs answering patient FAQs about upper blepharoplasty, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
